evidence.text:
賈公閭後妻郭氏

酷妒有男兒名黎民生載周充自外還乳母抱兒在
中庭兒見充喜踊充就乳母手中嗚之郭遥望見謂
充愛乳母即殺之兒悲思啼泣不飲它乳遂死郭後
終無子

judgment.explanation: 賈謐 is a well-known historical figure, the son of Jia Chong's daughter (Jia Wu) and thus grandson of Jia Chong. The annotation mentions 賈謐母 (Jia Mi's mother) alongside 趙充華. The candidate c0 is the local person form 賈謐, matching the mention surface exactly. This is the historical Jia Mi, son of Jia Chong's daughter.
